case_title.quote: STATE OF A. P. v. M. SOHAN BABU & ANR.

number_of_accused.quote: the two accused, duly armed, had entered the premises

accused_gender.quote: A2 thereupon took out a knife from the right side of his hip pocket
accused_gender.reason: A2 is referred to as male; the other accused is not described otherwise.

accused_age.reason: Age of accused is not stated.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the two accused had entered the premises at mid night duly armed with the intention of committing robbery
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Intruders for robbery; no prior relationship indicated.

offence_category.quote: restore that of the trial court

statutory_provisions.quote: under Sections 302/34, 460 and 324 of the Indian Penal Code

weapon.quote: armed with knives which they had used repeatedly and effectively

evidence_type.quote: relying on the evidence of the aforesaid witnesses as supported by the medical evidence
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness and medical are right; 'circumstantial' is not supported.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: they too were caused injuries and threatened with dire consequences

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted and sentenced the accused under Sections 302/34, 460 and 324

high_court_outcome.quote: modified the conviction to one under Section 304 Part I IPC

offence_finally_established.quote: restore that of the trial court

imprisonment_type.quote: restore that of the trial court
imprisonment_type.reason: No sentence is stated in the judgment.

imprisonment_years.quote: restore that of the trial court
imprisonment_years.reason: No term of years is mentioned anywhere.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Accused entered at midnight; scuffle with deceased, who pinned A2; A2 stabbed his abdomen, A1 stabbed his thighs; others injured; accused tied up.
neutral_facts.quote: A2 thereupon took out a knife ... and stabbed the deceased on the left side of the abdomen
neutral_facts.reason: Mostly accurate, but the sequence is muddled and duplicated; stabbing is attributed to both jointly.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment states no penalty range for Section 302.

attempt_completion.quote: he succumbed to his injuries on the way

physical_harm.quote: he succumbed to his injuries on the way ... Their injuries were found to be simple
physical_harm.reason: Death and simple injuries to others.

number_of_offences.quote: restore that of the trial court

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Court found armed entry for robbery; intent to kill was inferred from circumstances during the incident, not planned.
premeditation_planning.quote: The initial purpose was to commit robbery, but as the accused were armed with knives ... they were willing to kill as well
premeditation_planning.reason: Robbery intent planned; intent to kill inferred during incident, not premeditated.

motive.quote: The initial purpose was to commit robbery

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: A2 stabbed the deceased in the abdomen; A1 and A2 caused thigh injuries; the accused also injured neighbours.
key_evidence_accepted.quote: A2 had caused one injury in the stomach ... Two injuries were thereafter caused on the thigh
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Thigh injuries are attributed to A1, not only A2.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Trial court relied on the witnesses' evidence; the Supreme Court does not assess credibility.
witness_credibility.quote: The trial court relying on the evidence of the aforesaid witnesses
witness_credibility.reason: The Supreme Court did not assess credibility.

post_offence_conduct.quote: they were tied up with a rope and information was also sent to the police

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence 20/21 Nov 1991; High Court judgment 11.12.2003; SC 14 Dec 2010; trial date not stated
trial_duration.quote: From the Judgment & Order dated 11.12.2003 of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh
trial_duration.reason: 11.12.2003 is the High Court judgment date, not the trial judgment.

legal_representation.correct_value: Appellant State: I. Venkatanarayana, Ramesh Allanki, D. Mahesh Babu; Respondents (accused): Anil Kumar Tandale, Manoj C. Mishra, Brajesh Jha
legal_representation.quote: I. Venkatanarayana, Ramesh Allanki, D. Mahesh Babu for the Appellant.
legal_representation.reason: Counsel roles are reversed; the appellant is the State.

investigation_status.correct_value: Police informed; trial and appeals completed; FIR and charge sheet not stated.
investigation_status.quote: information was also sent to the police
investigation_status.reason: FIR and charge sheet are not mentioned.

appeal_history.quote: We, accordingly, set aside this part of the High Court judgment and restore that of the trial court.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: State challenged the High Court's conversion to s.304 Part I; arguments are not recorded in detail.
prosecution_argument.quote: It is this part of the judgment which has been challenged by the State of Andhra Pradesh
prosecution_argument.reason: Content comes from the court's reasoning, not recorded arguments.

defence_argument.reason: No defence argument is recorded; the 'accident' reasoning is the High Court's.

legal_principle_applied.quote: the common intention can be inferred from the circumstances of the case and that the intention can be gathered from the circumstances as they arise even during an incident

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: No sentence discussed; the conviction under s.302 was restored because the High Court's s.304 Part I finding was erroneous.
sentencing_rationale.quote: the High Court's observation that the matter fell under Section 304 Part I and not under Section 302 of the IPC is erroneous
sentencing_rationale.reason: Describes conviction reasoning, not a sentence.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Armed midnight entry, repeated effective use of knives, and injuries to neighbours were stressed, though not for sentencing.
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: they had used repeatedly and effectively
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court stressed these circumstances in restoring the murder conviction.
